title: Best Real Estate Video Editors (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a real estate video editor or promo creator for property listings: what to include, formats, accuracy, price factors and red flags.
intro: Real estate promo videos show properties in a way photos cannot: flow between rooms, light, views and the neighborhood. Online editors turn raw footage, photos and drone clips into polished listing videos and social clips. Videos go wrong when editing misrepresents the property, music is not licensed, or the video does not fit listing platforms. This guide helps you produce videos that attract buyers honestly.

faq.q: Can a video be made from photos only?
faq.a: Yes. Editors can create slideshow-style videos with movement, text and music from listing photos. Footage usually gives a better sense of space.
Horizontal for listing sites and YouTube, vertical for social media. Check each platform's length and size limits.

faq.q: Should the video include agent branding?
faq.a: Usually yes: logo, contact details and a short intro or outro. Check any rules your agency or listing platform has.
Drone flights are regulated in many places. Make sure whoever films has the required permissions; the editor only edits footage you provide.
Color correction and stabilization are normal. Editing that hides defects or changes features can mislead buyers and may break advertising rules.
